newsitem.title: UK: UBE to supply Discovery with Survival show.
newsitem.headline: UBE to supply Discovery with Survival show.

text.p: United Broadcasting & Entertainment (UBE) said on Friday that it has agreed a deal with Discovery Communications to supply the back catalogue of its flagship natural history producer Survival.
UBE, the broadcasting and entertainment division of United News & Media Plc, said in a statement that the deal will yield up to $55 million extra revenues over seven years from 1997.
Discovery will buy worldwide cable and satellite rights to 180 hours of Survival programming, plus rights to the entire back catalogue for Latin America and the majority of Europe.
